newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel further eases West Bank, Gaza closure.
newsitem.headline: Israel further eases West Bank, Gaza closure.

text.p: Israel said on Wednesday it would let in another 800 Palestinian labourers to work and raise the number of Palestinian professionals allowed into Arab East Jerusalem from other parts of the West Bank.

An army spokeswoman said the easing of the closure Israel imposed on the West Bank and Gaza Strip in February -- which has been tightened and relaxed a number of times -- would take effect at 0200 GMT on Thursday.
She said 300 "shift workers in central services" would be allowed in from Gaza and 500 from the West Bank.
In addition the number of teachers allowed into East Jerusalem from other parts of the West Bank would be increased to 600 and tourism workers to 200.
Before Wednesday's announcement 18,000 workers were entering Israel from Gaza and 20,000 from the West Bank, Palestinian sources said.

Up to 60,000 Palestinians had worked in Israel before the closure. The Palestinian Authority in charge of self-rule enclaves set up in the areas under interim peace deals with Israel says the closures are collective punishment and have devastated the Palestinian economy.
The February closure was imposed after the first in a series of four Moslem militant suicide bomb attacks in nine days that killed 59 people in Israel.
